_comment: FramePack long-take graph (LEGACY, unmaintained upstream). Purpose: ONE continuous 60-120 s shot at 30 fps from a single still, on 6 GB of VRAM, for scenes that must not cut (a slow reveal, a monologue walk). Requires the community wrapper node pack (ComfyUI-FramePackWrapper). This graph is intentionally NOT the default: the upstream repo is effectively abandoned, so pin your model files. Duration is expressed in seconds, not frames.

1._note: Constant-size frame context: generation cost does not grow with clip length.
